text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen from 104,088 to 96,539 despite an early rise, so I should assess risk and my plan rather than take comfort in brief gains.","I made no trades as losses accumulated; avoiding a decision can also have consequences, so I should review each holding against its current merits and rebalance when warranted.","Because past price moves do not predict future moves, I should avoid frequent reactive trading and use clear position limits and a deliberate process."]}
